Name: Darkness
Components: V, M (bat fur and a drop of pitch, or piece of coal)
Description:
Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners.

A creature with darkvision can’t see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can’t illuminate it.

If the point you choose is on an object you are holding or one that isn’t being worn or carried, the darkness emanates from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the source of the darkness with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the darkness.

If any of this spell’s area overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell that created the light is dispelled.

Dark Mind Bonus. If a sorcerer or warlock casts this spell, it is treated as being cast two levels higher.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for every two levels above 2nd:
● The radius of the sphere doubles.
● (4 levels) You do not need to concentrate on this spell, and may end its effects as a bonus action.
